messages:
maria: FYI nightly perf alert — ~8% p95 regression on small-seq workloads vs our baseline from 2026-03-15. Perf bot attached a summary. Looks correlated with yesterday's kernel-selector flip (prefer_fp16_kernels=true). Anyone else seeing this? @aj @sam :eyes:
perf-bot: [ALERT] nightly-bench: small-seq p95 +8% vs baseline. Threshold=5%. Opened perf-diff ticket perf-diffs/1832104321. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/p/bench/nightly?panel=small-seq
aj: Noted. Kernel selector change now prefers fused-attn for seq<=64. If batching mixes seq lengths, fused kernel can be slower than non-fused fallback. Also maybe sensitive to KV cache warmup state.
sam: I can run the replay harness with kv warmup toggled. Which commit should I target?
maria: Use commit 9f7b2c3 (kernel-selector: prefer_fp16_kernels=true). Command to reproduce: `./ci/run_bench.py --replay --commit 9f7b2c3 --workload small-seq --runs 5 --kv-warmup true` — also run with `--kv-warmup false`.
lei: Also try synthetic stressing for batching: `./tools/loadgen --profile kernels --qps 200 --seq 32 --duration 10m` — capture batch size histogram and kernel hit rates.
david: I suspect batching heuristics too. Recent change made the batcher group by (model,device) only, not seq-length. That will mix short/long and trash fused-attn assumptions. I'll revert locally and test.
aj: I'll run both replays and capture perf traces. To get kernel timeline: `export PERF_TRACE=1; ./ci/run_bench.py --replay --commit 9f7b2c3 ...` — will attach flamegraphs.
sam: Quick local flamegraph shows fused-attn takes +30% time under mixed batch composition; fallback kernels spike and increase variance in tokens/sec.
perf-bot: nightly-dashboard updated: https://grafana.redwood/p/bench/nightly — kernel breakdown, batch size hist, kv-warmup toggle.
maria: For flaky-triage: propose we only escalate if regression reproduces in >=3/5 runs AND is confirmed with the replay harness within 2 hours. Otherwise mark as flaky and queue for investigation. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
lei: +1. Also add kv-warmup as a CI matrix axis so we cover warm and cold cache regularly (not just once in a while).
ci-bot: Created job `nightly-bench-matrix-kv` (matrix: kv_warmup=[true,false], seq=[32,64], batcher=[seq-grouping,device-only]). Job id nbm-20260318-01.
david: Reproduced locally: reverting the batcher change restores p95 to baseline on small-seq. Opening rollback PR #2467, marking as urgent. :rocket:
aj: In addition, kernel selector should consider the effective batch composition (seq-length histogram) before choosing fused kernels. I'll draft a heuristic patch to fall back when >30% of batch has seq mismatch.
sam: I'll add a deterministic harness config that pins batcher mode to `seq-grouping` and kernel hints so we can do apples-to-apples comparisons between commits. Will commit a config under `ci/configs/bench/consistency.yaml`.
maria: Please also add the exact replay command used to validate into the dashboard metadata as `last-verified-command`. Saves time.
lei: On it — adding `replay_command` and `commit` tags to nightly metadata and pushing to Grafana.
david: PR #2467 (rollback) posted and linked from perf-diffs/1832104321. CC @eng-oncall.
eng-oncall: ack. I'll monitor rollback and validate metrics once CI publishes.
maria: Thanks everyone. We'll let the nightly matrix run and re-evaluate tomorrow morning. If rollback fixes it we merge and follow up on the selector heuristic patch.
aj: thx, running now.
sam: on it, will post flamegraphs to the perf ticket.
lei: pushed dashboard metadata change.
perf-bot: [RESOLVED] alert cleared after rollback job nbm-20260318-01 produced baseline-matching metrics in 4/5 runs. See perf-diffs/1832104321/resolve for details. :white_check_mark:
maria: great work. We should add a gating rule: require matrix check (kv true/false + batcher modes) before kernel-selector merges. Will propose in PR review checklist.
aj: agreed. I'll add a CI presubmit that runs a tiny replay sample to catch these regressions early.
sam: added the deterministic harness config; leaving notes in the perf ticket.
david: closing loop on rollback, will follow-up with a cleaned selector patch that uses batch histogram.
maria: nice. closing thread — will reopen if CI shows any new drift. :pray:
